source_note: 两张2013实拍交叉核对正殿，不用后来山门和院落阁楼。去除古树、香炉及临时悬饰遮挡，图鉴式概括七开间、重檐庑殿和现有窗门。首稿误作五间已弃用，最终稿七间八根前檐柱已目视复核。非测绘复原。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Subject: the actual DABEI HALL of CHONGSHAN TEMPLE in TAIYUAN 太原崇善寺大悲殿, surviving early Ming imperial timber hall. Images2 and3 show complementary near-frontal views of the SAME hall from slightly different positions. Geometry: a VERY BROAD seven-bay facade, ONE central double-leaf door and THREE bays of wooden lattice windows to either side, EIGHT structural front columns, a single tall hall with TWO EAVE LEVELS and a HIPPED ROOF (double-eaved WUDIAN 重檐庑殿, not a gable wall). The upper roof is long and low-pitched with a long level ridge and modest upward curvature at the hipped ends. Preserve the actual wide horizontal outline and tightly spaced upper and lower eaves, timber columns supporting the front eaves and a raised continuous low stone platform with long shallow front steps. Image2 establishes the main seven-bay front and right roof end; image3 confirms central entrance and two-tier eaves. Remove trees, incense burners, foreground red pillar, flags and lanterns, neighboring gallery, air-conditioner and visitors. Simplify lattices into a few fine grid lines, roofs into almost blank planes with a few short ridge details. Do not create extra buildings or an eight-bay hall. No gabled end wall on facade. Keep central plaque as a blank vertical board without calligraphy. Keep proportions close to photos, correct the mild perspective to nearfrontal, draw the WHOLE seven-bay hall with both eave levels, roof corners, platform and steps entirely in frame. Landscape1536x1024, isolated centered at82%width with large white margins. Fine sparse BLACK contour drawing, no filled dark windows, no roof hatch or wood grain.
COUNT REQUIREMENT OVERRIDES EVERY OTHER DETAIL: exactly SEVEN STRUCTURAL BAYS separated by EIGHT full-height front pillars. Read left to right: PILLAR 1, window BAY 1, PILLAR 2, window BAY 2, PILLAR 3, window BAY 3, PILLAR 4, central-door BAY 4, PILLAR 5, window BAY 5, PILLAR 6, window BAY 6, PILLAR 7, window BAY 7, PILLAR 8. Three separate equal-width window bays to the LEFT of the door, three to the RIGHT. Each bay can have just ONE coarse simple lattice panel. The two columns flanking the center door are pillar4 and5. Do not produce the common FIVE-BAY temple template. Seven bays, eight columns, long narrow overall facade. Top eave level also shows seven-bay rhythm. Scale the complete building to 85%canvas width so at least100px white margin remains on EACH side of a1536pxwidecanvas. All eave tips entirely uncut. Keep window lattice much sparser than phototrace: only6by6large rectangular cells per window.

historical_sources.evidence: 依据大悲殿研究性保护项目的一手调查，明确现存大悲殿为洪武朝木结构官式高等级佛殿，记录2019年起研究性保护及结构纠偏背景。

historical_sources.evidence: 大悲殿七间四进深、重檐庑殿；1864火灾幸存主体与1882新建山门、钟鼓楼分别记录。洪武营建起年存在不同记载，图版不强定单一竣工年。

site_recommendation.name: 太原崇善寺
site_recommendation.sub: 大悲殿 · 明初官式木构
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1385仅为洪武朝的时间轴约略定位，不作为精确竣工年。寺院沿革和清代山门不代替所绘明代主体的年代。
site_recommendation.lede: 七开间的大悲殿沿院落横向展开，重檐之下仍保存明初官式佛殿的尺度。经历寺院火灾与格局变迁，幸存的殿堂成为认识洪武建筑的重要实物。

facts.label: 洪武遗构
facts.text: 现存大悲殿属明洪武朝官式高等级佛殿，木构与殿内造像均有重要研究价值。

facts.label: 七间重檐
facts.text: 大殿面阔七间、进深四间，重檐庑殿顶，图版突出两重檐口与七间柱网。

facts.label: 火后幸存
facts.text: 清同治三年大火后大悲殿幸存；后来重建的山门、钟鼓楼与原明代殿堂分别登记。
